items.title: Frank Strazzeri interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: his favorite trumpet player, at least that was the impression he gave me, were Clifford Brown and Dizzy and those kind of guys.

ctx.x: Wow. And he went from that to “Java.”

Yeah. But his favorite trumpet player, at least that was the impression he gave me, were Clifford Brown and Dizzy and those kind of guys. So he was a true trumpet player. It was just, that was his bag of playing.
Was your wife into this music you did too?
